test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-4) Official paper (Held On: 10 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The least populated district of India as per 2011 Census is located in which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arunachal Pradesh.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **Dibang valley district **of** Arunachal Pradesh **displays the **lowest population in the country** with a population of **7,948.**
 
• Dibang Valley is a district of Arunachal Pradesh **named after the Dibang River** or the **Talon**
